raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

This ROCm bugfix, with no speed change, turns off the fused K/V allocation from #32272 on ROCm, because with it the MI35x PD disaggregation test `test_disaggregation_basic.py` returns garbage on every AMD PR.

#32272 changed `MHATokenToKVPool` to store each layer's K and V as block-aligned halves of one allocation, so `v_buffer[i]` now starts inside the allocation of `k_buffer[i]`. Only the trtllm_mha fmha_v2 prefill on CUDA reads that layout, but the allocation change has no platform gate. The test serves Qwen3-8B with Mooncake, prefill and decode on one MI35x node. The decode server now returns nonsense with no transfer error:

```
FAIL: test_gsm8k (__main__.TestDisaggregationAccuracy.test_gsm8k)
AssertionError: 0.005 not greater than 0.7
```

The MI35x 8-GPU disaggregation job ran on many PRs on 2026-10-27. Grouped by the main commit each run merged onto:

| main base | jobs | `test_disaggregation_basic.py` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `db90f584d2`, `2b36c718cb`, `e4d4a9a7de` (before #32272) | 9 | passed in all 9 ([example](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40464519661/job/122061186617)) |
| `1a120754e0` (#32272) and every later base seen (`d3a157a2f2`, `61a676125a`, `449617bc94`, `3927a73a34`, `8a455f1b90`, `a6f5bd397b`) | 9 | failed in all 9, GSM8K accuracy 0.0 to 0.01 ([first](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40468145469/job/122072975234)) |

Seven of the nine earlier jobs failed in `test_disaggregation_pp.py`, which also fails on main's scheduled runs. `test_disaggregation_basic.py` passed in each of them.

Three other commits sit between `e4d4a9a7de` and `1a120754e0`. They are #31286 (removes an unused HiCache field), #46366 (gfx1250 diffusion GEMM) and #33743 (flashinfer TRT-LLM MoE weight reload). None of them touches the KV pool or PD. Every job ran on a different runner, so one bad machine does not explain it.

Mooncake's HIP transport carries the same-node transfer. It registers each KV buffer with its own `hipIpcGetMemHandle` and maps peer addresses as `dest - entry.addr + shm_addr`. With the fused layout, both handles of a layer point into one allocation. I did not find which step then puts V at the wrong address, so the evidence here is the bisect, not a mechanism.

## Modifications

- In `memory_pool.py`, the fused allocation now also needs `not _is_hip`. ROCm gets back the two `torch.zeros` per layer it had before #32272.
- In `test_mha_pool_fused_kv_layout.py`, a new CPU test patches `_is_hip` and checks that K and V do not share storage. The existing fused-layout test still runs on the CPU runner, where `_is_hip` is false. Both tests build the pool with a shared `_make_pool` helper.

Off ROCm this change does nothing. On ROCm nothing reads the fused layout, because fmha_v2 runs only on CUDA, so the only effect there is the allocation from before #32272.

## Accuracy Tests

I have not run it on MI35x. The AMD disaggregation job of this PR is the end-to-end check, and I will post its result here.

The CPU unit test on this branch and on main:

| | `test_v_is_block_aligned_offset_from_k` | `test_rocm_keeps_k_and_v_in_separate_allocations` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| this PR | pass | pass |
| main | pass | fail (`AssertionError: 4573659136 == 4573659136 : layer 0`) |

Untested: same-node PD on CUDA through an IPC transport, which could meet the same layout.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

None. ROCm goes back to the allocation it used before #32272. CUDA is unchanged, so it keeps the fmha_v2 speedup from #32272.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (isort 7.0.0, ruff 0.15.1 check and format)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed, no user-facing option changes.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Pending the MI35x PD job of this PR.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

-                    if k_shape == v_shape:
+                    # Only CUDA's trtllm fmha_v2 prefill reads the fused layout,
+                    # and same-node Mooncake PD on ROCm decodes garbage when V
+                    # sits inside K's allocation, so ROCm allocates them apart.
+                    if k_shape == v_shape and not _is_hip:
                         # Store K and V as block-aligned halves of one allocation
                         # so paged kernels with a single pool base can reach V
                         # via block offsets. Each half keeps its standalone

@@ -2,15 +2,18 @@
 
 trtllm_mha's fmha_v2 prefill reaches V from k_cache's base pointer via int32
 block offsets and falls back to a full-pool copy (with only a warning) when
-the layout breaks. This pins the invariant that path relies on.
+the layout breaks. This pins the invariant that path relies on. ROCm keeps K
+and V in separate allocations.
 
     python -m pytest test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_mha_pool_fused_kv_layout.py -v
 """
 
 import unittest
+from unittest import mock
 
 import torch
 
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache import memory_pool
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import MHATokenToKVPool
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 
@@ -21,21 +24,25 @@
 LAYER_NUM = 2
 
 
+def _make_pool(page_size):
+    return MHATokenToKVPool(
+        size=page_size * 7,
+        page_size=page_size,
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        head_num=HEAD_NUM,
+        head_dim=HEAD_DIM,
+        layer_num=LAYER_NUM,
+        device="cpu",
+        enable_memory_saver=False,
+        enable_alt_stream=False,
+    )
+
+
 class TestMHAPoolFusedKVLayout(unittest.TestCase):
     def test_v_is_block_aligned_offset_from_k(self):
         for page_size in (16, 32, 64):
             with self.subTest(page_size=page_size):

+                pool = _make_pool(page_size)
                 for layer_id in range(LAYER_NUM):

                     # Same paged view and block size the fmha_v2 path computes.
@@ -47,6 +54,17 @@ def test_v_is_block_aligned_offset_from_k(self):
                     self.assertEqual(rem, 0, f"layer {layer_id}")
                     self.assertGreater(delta, 0, f"layer {layer_id}")
 
+    def test_rocm_keeps_k_and_v_in_separate_allocations(self):
+        with mock.patch.object(memory_pool, "_is_hip", True):
+            pool = _make_pool(page_size=16)
+        for layer_id in range(LAYER_NUM):
+            k_buf, v_buf = pool.get_kv_buffer(layer_id)
+            self.assertNotEqual(
+                k_buf.untyped_storage().data_ptr(),
+                v_buf.untyped_storage().data_ptr(),
